notes: PDF system card (317 pages) via Anthropic CDN redirect from the seed URL. Seed maps both Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5 to anthropic/claude-fable-5; distinguished via settings.other/safeguards. Knowledge cutoff not stated. Many figure-only charts (multi-turn harmfulness, political bias pairwise, some cyber/capability plots) lack extractable cell numbers and were skipped. Eval results prioritize RSP/cyber/safeguards/agentic safety plus Table 8.1.A and key capability prose scores; not every Section 8 subsection number was transcribed (cap well under 600). Andon Labs page text has a glued footnote marker in “Fable 516”. Special Unicode (zero-width spaces, curly apostrophes) present in PDF text; quotes copied verbatim.
